_comment: Defaults for the settings screen. Player choices are saved to user://settings.cfg.
_ui_scale_comment: Interface size: 0 is Auto (the largest scale step that fits the window). A fixed size is capped so the view never gets smaller than display.min_size.
_scale_mode_comment: Scaling: fit scales the 1280x820 design up to fill the window (sharp text, art pixels a little uneven at in-between sizes); crisp uses whole scale_step steps only. TODO(decision: ui-scale-mode): fit is the default.

display._comment: How the game fills the window (ui/common/window_fit.gd). min_size is the smallest view the layouts are built for, in interface pixels, and the smallest window. Above it the scale grows in scale_step steps, which keeps the pixel art (drawn at 2x) crisp; below it the view shrinks to fit.
